content: Human-labeling session — mcv-deploy-defensible-site:hard seed 1. Objective: Same chokepoint geometry, but the MCV spawns at one of two latitudes by seed. The DEFENSIBLE side is the WEST lobe BEHIND the water wall — the win predicate accepts either the SW pocket (15,30) or the NW pocket (15,10). Two stacked rusher bands hit any EAST-lobe deploy. Read your start latitude, route through the corridor to the closer DEFENSIBLE pocket, deploy, build power and barracks, hold one unit. Within about 54 turns.
